title: three-seed promotion test of exp_023's block-selected arm (k=400 x league) against the deployed d (k=111 x self)

arms.A_control: k=111 x self at the CONTROL beta = exp_022 G1f = the d of deployed candidates H/I
arms.B_candidate: k=400 x league, beta re-fitted on supply blocks = exp_023's block-selected arm

changed_vs_exp_023: seeds 7 and 2024 are added; their three base B3 vectors (blocks 2022, 2023 and fold_2024) are TRAINED here — exp_023 had none
only two arms are evaluated on fold_2024; exp_023's other 11 distinct arms are not re-run there
the block selection is re-run per seed as a DIAGNOSTIC
b3_block.py gains a 2024 unit spec and a seed argument, and its reproduction gate fires only at seed 42 (see that file's docstring)
unchanged_vs_exp_023: d construction (dev_k.py byte-identical, expanded form B), league table (backoff.py byte-identical), exp_004 F-mask, clip 1e-6, closed-form no-intercept slope, supply blocks 2022+2023, iter 170/650/650, cell iter 240/240/1150, num_threads 6

reproduction_gate.on_fail: abort — the reused vectors or the inherited code are not exp_023's and no seed comparison downstream is readable

codepath_check_seed42_fold_2024.purpose: prove exp_024's fold_2024 code path is exp_020's, so that the three seeds differ only by seed
codepath_check_seed42_fold_2024.used_for_arm_evaluation: NO — exp_020's stored vector is used, sha asserted, exactly as the spec requires

asof_independent_recheck.method: row_id -> season re-read from train.csv in a second pass; the table masks are re-derived and the max season of the CONTRIBUTING ROW IDS is looked up in that independent map

decision.rule: PRE-REGISTERED (config.yaml adoption_criterion, same as exp_018 and exp_021): same sign on all 3 seeds AND |mean delta| >= 3 x CONTROL-arm seed std (ddof=1).  Not relaxable after the fact.
decision.note: the paired-delta std is reported because the shared base makes it the natural spread of the quantity of interest, and it is expected to be smaller than the control's.  It is NOT the denominator of the registered test.

reselection_diagnostic_summary.meaning: if the seeds disagree, the SELECTION PROCEDURE is seed-sensitive — a separate finding from whether the selected arm beats the control.

reselection_diagnostic.discipline: DIAGNOSTIC.  The arm under test is fixed at k400_league by pre-registration; this cannot change it.

league_target_risk_UNRESOLVED.warning: the `league` target puts L on CELL-HIT rows as well, so the pitcher-hand-2 cells reach rows the hard backoff never touched.  Those cells' L flips sign across vintages (-0.0077 in the 2020 table, +0.0024 in the 2024 one).  THIS EXPERIMENT DOES NOT ADDRESS THAT.  A three-seed pass is about base-model noise, not about whether the league cell is stable out of sample.

conversion.sensitivity: brier 1e-6 = score 0.4003; a 6-decimal Brier carries +-0.2002 in the converted number
conversion.caveat: local measurement is at iter 650 (<=2023 training); the deployed build is iter 7700 (<=2024).

leak_boundary.tables: row of season s uses seasons <= s-1 only; verified twice — at runtime, and independently by re-reading train.csv and looking the contributing row_ids' seasons up again
leak_boundary.beta_fit: supply blocks 2022+2023 of the same seed only
leak_boundary.arm_choice: fixed by pre-registration before any 2024 number was read; the per-seed block argmin is diagnostic
leak_boundary.design_matrix: unchanged — no deviation is ever a model feature
